known_physical_boundaries.rule: Historical reconstruction writes backtest/replay evidence, not current forecasts.
Paper P&L may read outcomes but may not fabricate or rewrite them.
It is a controller; each child writer is charged to its declared lane.

CURRENT_MARKET_RESEARCH.purpose: Scan current markets and produce forecasts, rankings, and shadow evidence.
CURRENT_MARKET_RESEARCH.writes: Current catalog, source, link, feature, quote, forecast, ranking, and shadow data.

GH2_OPERATIONAL_SOAK.purpose: Prove bounded operational health and safety.
GH2_OPERATIONAL_SOAK.writes: Health, stage, source-readiness, soak, and invariant evidence only.

GUARDED_PAPER_LEARNING.purpose: Create and evaluate explicitly authorized simulated paper positions.
GUARDED_PAPER_LEARNING.writes: Paper orders, fills, positions, P&L, sizing, risk, and paper-learning evidence.

HISTORICAL_REPLAY.purpose: Produce no-lookahead historical and settled model evaluations.
HISTORICAL_REPLAY.writes: Replay, backtest, settlement, calibration, memory, and evaluation evidence.

shared_read_contracts: All lanes read the same semantic market definitions.
All lanes read the same model, feature, EV, and fee definitions.
Historical Replay owns canonical settlements; Guarded Paper consumes them read-only.
GH-2 consumes current-market evidence but never increments research or paper counters.
